Later, the Petitioner filed Petition No. 248/TT/2017 for truing-up of the fee and charges allowed for Assets-I, II and III for the period from COD of the respective assets to 31.3.2014 and for determination of fee and charges for Asset-IV from its COD on 1.3.2014 to 31.3.2014. The Commission disposed of the said petition as the information required for reassessment of the capital cost was not available, vide order dated 20.9.2018 with a liberty to the Petitioner to file a fresh petition after the approval of the RCE by the Petitioner’s Board of Directions. The observations made by the Commission in order dated in this regard are as under: [para 13] 13. In this order, the fee and charges allowed for Assets-I, II and III for the 2009-14 period vide order dated 15.9.2016 in Petition No. 57/TT/2014 is trued up and tariff for the 2014-19 period is allowed for the said assets. Besides this, the final trued up tariff for Asset-IV is also allowed in this order as per the principles laid down in order dated 8.12.2011 in Petition No. 68/2010. [para 24] 24. The Petitioner, vide Auditor’s Certificates dated 18.2.2019, has submitted actual expenditure in case of Assets-I, II, III and Asset-IV corresponding to Central Portion as well as State Portion separately. The details of the Apportioned Approved Cost, Capital Cost as on COD and additional capitalization incurred for the instant OPGW links covered during 2012-13 and 2013-14 are as follows:- [para 25] 25. The gross value of the assets submitted by the Petitioner as on COD have been considered for the purpose of true-up of fee and charges of 2009-14 period. [para 42] 42. On the basis of the above, the Capital Cost considered and its recovery during 2009-14 period, the Net Capital cost of the Assets as on 31.3.2014 is derived as [para 47] 47. The Petitioner has claimed the following additional capital expenditure during 2014-19 and the same is considered for calculation of fee and charges for 2014-19 period: [para 62] 62. The fee and charges allowed in this order for the 2009-14 period for the Central Portion shall be shared by the respondents in accordance with Para 44 of the Order dated 15.9.2016 in Petition No. 57/TT/2014. [para 63] 63. The fees and charges allowed for the State Portion for the 2009-14 period in this order shall be shared by the respective State in proportion to the capital cost belonging to respective State.
